Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Options Web team builds the web experiences that let customers trade options on Robinhood. The team works across Robinhood.com and Legend, our web trading platform for active traders. Its work covers trading flows, options onboarding for new customers, and monitoring tools. On Legend, the team builds the options pieces, including options details in the positions widget and the Option Chain tool. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and the mobile options team, and you'll see your work reach customers fast!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Act as tech lead for options on web, setting direction on platform topics such as performance and observability
  • Design, build, test, and roll out features in React and TypeScript across trading flows, options onboarding, and monitoring tools
  • Own projects end to end, from options team projects to large efforts that involve cross-team collaboration.
  • Break larger projects into smaller pieces and guide other engineers as they build them
  • Diagnose complex performance problems and data issues, including options calculations, find the root cause, and set up monitoring to catch problems early
  • Partner with product managers and designers (and content designers when needed) to shape and ship customer-facing features
  • Work with the mobile options team so options features feel consistent across platforms

What you bring

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong web engineering fundamentals, with hands-on experience building production web applications in React and TypeScript
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a record of finding root causes in performance and data problems
  • Experience owning projects end to end, from design through development, testing, and rollout
  • Experience leading projects and setting technical direction, such as improving performance or observability
  • Clear communication about technical tradeoffs with engineers, product managers, and designers
  • Nice to have: familiarity with options trading or other fintech and trading products (no options experience is required, and we'll teach you the domain)
  • Nice to have: prior tech lead experience, including at smaller companies

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

We are seeking

Bitdeer (NASDAQ: BTDR) is looking for an experienced transactional attorney to join our U.S. Legal team in San Jose, California as Senior Legal Counsel, Power & Land. Bitdeer acquires, energizes and builds data center and power infrastructure across multiple U.S. states and in Alberta, Canada. This role owns the legal work that moves a site from a land position to an energized facility: acquisitions, leases and easements; water rights and supply; utility, interconnection and energy management arrangements; long-lead electrical equipment; and the entitlements and regulatory approvals each site depends on.

This is a dedicated power and land role in our U.S. legal function, so you will own the portfolio rather than support it. You will work directly with site selection, development, construction, energy and procurement leaders, bring in and direct specialist and local counsel where state and local law requires it, and build the form agreements, diligence standards and obligation tracking that this work depends upon.

What you will be responsible for

  • Lead land and site transactions end to end — purchase and sale agreements, ground and build-to-suit leases, options, easements and rights-of-way, title and survey review, title insurance, restrictive covenants, water rights and supply agreements, and post-closing obligations.
  • Negotiate the utility and power arrangements that make a site viable: interconnection and transmission agreements, discretionary and distribution service agreements, substation and shared facilities agreements, energy management and retail supply arrangements, and the financial security, milestone and energization obligations inside them.
  • Advise on interconnection strategy and queue position with transmission and distribution service providers, electric cooperatives and system operators — including ERCOT, PJM and TVA territories and the Alberta market — and on large-load thresholds, study processes and cost allocation.
  • Support site selection and diligence: zoning and land use, entitlements and permitting, environmental review, utility and water availability, and the tax incentive, abatement and special district structures that determine whether a site clears.
  • Lead the land use and entitlement workstream with local counsel — rezoning and text amendments, moratoria, variances, and public hearings — and prepare the business for the public and political dimension of those proceedings.
  • Paper and negotiate procurement of long-lead electrical infrastructure such as transformers, switchgear and substation equipment, including origin representations, substitution and walk-away rights, and compliance with bulk-power-system and trade-control requirements.
  • Partner with the construction team on the interface between site, power and EPC paper, so interconnection milestones, energization dates and construction schedules are consistent across documents rather than negotiated separately.
  • Serve as a legal point of contact for utilities, cooperatives, landowners, developers, and state and local authorities, and select and manage specialist and local counsel in each market on scope, quality and spend.
  • Build the form library and standards for this work — letters of intent, options, easements, interconnection and diligence checklists — and maintain correct entity, signature and authority discipline across a multi-entity structure.
  • Track and surface continuing obligations: purchase options, approval and consent windows, notice and cure deadlines, financial security postings, renewal dates and energization covenants.
  • Support management on other legal matters as assigned.

How you will stand out

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing. California admission is preferred; attorneys admitted in another U.S. jurisdiction should be eligible to register as Registered In-House Counsel in California.
  • 7+ years of transactional experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house, with a substantial share in real estate development, energy and power, or infrastructure project work.
  • A record of leading complex transactions end to end as the responsible attorney against sophisticated counterparties — structuring, drafting, negotiating and closing, not supporting someone else who does.
  • Direct experience with utility and interconnection arrangements, whether for data centers, generation, renewables, industrial load or midstream — including interconnection and service agreements, easements and rights-of-way, and negotiations with utilities and cooperatives.
  • Practical command of the real estate toolkit: purchase and sale, ground and build-to-suit leasing, title and survey, easements, zoning and land use, and the diligence that sits under each.
  • Experience managing specialist and local counsel across multiple states, and the judgment to decide what stays in-house and what goes out.
  • Clear writing and the ability to turn a dense issue into a decision and a next step for an executive or a counterparty.
  • High self-motivation and a collaborative style suited to a fast-growing, global company.
  • Ability to work with colleagues across Asia and North America, including some meetings outside U.S. business hours, and to travel to project sites, utility and regulatory meetings, and hearings as needed.
  • ERCOT experience specifically — large-load interconnection, Texas transmission and distribution service providers, and electric cooperatives — or comparable depth in PJM, TVA or the Alberta market.
  • In-house experience at a data center developer, hyperscaler, independent power producer, utility, or renewable energy developer.
  • Experience with construction and EPC contracting, or with long-lead electrical equipment procurement.
  • Familiarity with public-company disclosure obligations as they touch project timing and energization.
  • Experience with Canadian, and specifically Alberta, land and power matters.

What you will experience working with us

  • A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives.
  • An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start-up spirit.
  • A fast-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts.
  • The ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and AI computing industry.
  • Involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems.
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities.
  • Attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring.

Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK

Ripple Treasury (formerly GTreasury) is the leading innovator of integrated SaaS treasury and risk management solutions for the digital treasurer. Developed using the latest technology, Ripple Treasury helps empower organizations on their path to strategic treasury, by enabling total visibility into their cash, liquidity, payments and financial risk management.

At Ripple Treasury, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of a successful enterprise. As a Professional Services Consultant, you are the critical link between our cutting- edge technology and the real-world financial goals of our global clients. You aren't just implementing a platform; you are a digital architect and a trusted advisor. Your mission is to deeply understand a client's unique business environment, prescribe industry best practices, and architect a configuration that transforms their treasury operations into a powerhouse of efficiency.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Discovery & Strategy: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions to uncover client pain points, workflows, and technical requirements
  • Solution Architecture: Design and document the "To-Be" state, determining the optimal configuration of Ripple Treasury’s suite to meet specific client goals
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a subject matter expert, guiding clients through treasury best practices and helping them modernize legacy processes
  • Implementation & Configuration: Take a hands-on approach to configuring the platform, ensuring the technical setup aligns perfectly with the strategic vision
  • Enablement & Training: Facilitate high-impact training sessions that empower users and ensure the client realizes the maximum ROI from our solutions
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to provide client feedback and influence the future of our product roadmap

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 3+ years experience in client-facing solution consulting and/or software implementations, specifically in ERP or SaaS
  • Consultative Approach: experience in roles where you don’t just take orders; you ask "why," challenge the status quo, and lead clients toward better outcomes
  • Technical Proficiency: experience navigating complex software ecosystems and understanding how data flows between treasury systems, banks, and ERPs
  • Communication Skills: experience translating "tech-speak" into "CFO-speak," making complex financial concepts accessible and compelling
  • Treasury Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of cash management, payments, risk, or hedge accounting
  • Financial Fluency: Previous experience working with Corporate Treasury, Accounting, and/or Finance - comfortable discussing cash flow, debt, and financial risk

Do Your Best Work

  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

descriptions.job-1ri4tkn:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across Central & Eastern Europe and Central Asia. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.

The impact you will have:

  • Open new private sector accounts across CEE and Central Asia. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.

  • Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.

  • Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.

  • Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.

  • Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

  • Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in CEE or Central Asia, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.

  • A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.

  • Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.

  • Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.

  • Fluent English; Russian or a CEE relevant language is a strong plus.

  • Based in Poland and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.

  • You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.

  • Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with flexibility for Central Asia hours and occasional US calls on complex deals.

  • Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core hours overlapping CET, with flexibility for Central Asia hours and occasional US calls.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention.
